title: Mirror Room
statementMd:
Imagine an $*n* × *m*$ grid with some blocked cells. The top left cell in the grid has coordinates $(1, 1)$ and the bottom right cell has coordinates $(*n*, *m*)$. There are $*k*$ blocked cells in the grid and others are empty. You flash a laser beam from the center of an empty cell $(*x*_{*s*}, *y*_{*s*})$ in one of the diagonal directions (i.e. north-east, north-west, south-east or south-west). If the beam hits a blocked cell or the border of the grid it will reflect. The behavior of the beam reflection in different situations is depicted in the figure below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3237ed5d92c9b7d57becd4e38a51941149ccaec3.png)

After a while the beam enters an infinite cycle. Count the number of empty cells that the beam goes through at least once. We consider that the beam goes through cell if it goes through its center.

## Input

The first line of the input contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}, 0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5})$. Each of the next $*k*$ lines contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *m*)$ indicating the position of the $*i*$-th blocked cell.

The last line contains $*x*_{*s*}$, $*y*_{*s*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*s*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *y*_{*s*} ≤ *m*)$ and the flash direction which is equal to "`NE`", "`NW`", "`SE`" or "`SW`". These strings denote directions $( - 1, 1)$, $( - 1,  - 1)$, $(1, 1)$, $(1,  - 1)$.

It's guaranteed that no two blocked cells have the same coordinates.

## Output

In the only line of the output print the number of empty cells that the beam goes through at least once.

Please, do not write the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.
statementZhMd:
想象一个带有一些阻挡单元格的 $*n* × *m*$ 网格。网格左上角的单元格坐标为 $(1, 1)$，右下角的单元格坐标为 $(*n*, *m*)$。网格中有 $*k*$ 个阻挡单元格，其余单元格为空。你从一个空单元格的中心 $(*x*_{*s*}, *y*_{*s*})$ 向某个对角线方向（即东北、西北、东南或西南）发射一束激光。如果光束撞到阻挡单元格或网格边界，就会发生反射。光束在不同情况下的反射方式如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3237ed5d92c9b7d57becd4e38a51941149ccaec3.png)

一段时间后，光束会进入一个无限循环。请计算光束至少经过一次的空单元格数量。如果光束经过某个单元格的中心，则认为光束经过该单元格。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}, 0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{5})$。接下来的 $*k*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *y*_{*i*} ≤ *m*)$，表示第 $*i*$ 个阻挡单元格的位置。

最后一行包含 $*x*_{*s*}$、$*y*_{*s*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*s*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *y*_{*s*} ≤ *m*)$ 以及发射方向，该方向等于 "`NE`"、"`NW`"、"`SE`" 或 "`SW`"。这些字符串分别表示方向 $( - 1, 1)$、$( - 1,  - 1)$、$(1, 1)$、$(1,  - 1)$。

保证不存在坐标相同的两个阻挡单元格。

## 输出格式

输出一行，表示光束至少经过一次的空单元格数量。

请不要在 С++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。
